layout_decisions: Pub/Sub is drawn at project scope outside the regional frame; Cloud Run and Cloud SQL are regional resources.

Cloud Run services remain outside the VPC boundary. Only the actual VPC egress subnet is nested in the VPC frame; Cloud SQL remains a managed service outside that boundary and is reached over Private Services Access.
API and Worker are vertically offset to keep the Pub/Sub push route and the two data paths separate; API status reads and Worker result writes share the real private egress path without crossing.
The Monitoring uptime check uses a distinct orange OIDC path to the IAM-authenticated API; the API and Worker never grant allUsers.

Run service signals are grouped by destination: structured logs/log-based SLI metrics, sampled traces, and Monitoring SLO/dashboard/alerts. Sampling is labelled; the diagram does not imply trace completeness.
Orthogonal routes use short gutters, arrows terminate at destinations, and no route traverses an unrelated resource card.
API and Worker telemetry paths meet at a visible junction because both share the same Observability destinations.
